note: Discovery for the browsable page, and unsigned on purpose. Nothing above a source has authority: every source carries its own root keys, mirror list and signed index, and a tool resolves the source it was configured with — it never learns of one from here.

sources.description: The build environment's host tools, one package per platform: the compiler toolchain, the build system, the workspace tool and the wheel set the build's virtual environment is created from. Published with a meta package under the family name, which a build pins instead of one platform's package.
